sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: [WRONG_FORMULA] gen:TRF070ApplicableShipState sh:sparql: The declared DIRECT_CHECK is designConditionLocalStrengthCapacity >= localIcePressure, but the SPARQL constraint never compares those operands; it compares capacity against designConditionExpectedLoad while merely requiring localIcePressure to exist. This changes the mandatory regulatory comparison and does not establish any conversion or derivation connecting the pressure to the compared force load.
